text_en: Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父，米德杨的司祭耶特洛，听说天主为梅瑟和自己的百姓以色列所行的一切，听说上主将以色列人领出了埃及，

text_en: After Moses had sent away his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro took her back,
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父耶特洛便带回梅瑟送回去的妻子漆颇辣

text_en: along with her two sons. The name of the one was Gershom (for he said, “I have been an alien in a foreign land”),
text_cn: 和她的两个儿子：──一个名叫革尔熊，因为梅瑟说：“我在外方作了旅客；”

text_en: and the name of the other, Eliezer (for he said, “The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh”).
text_cn: 一个名叫厄里厄则尔，意谓：“我父亲的天主是我的救援，救我脱离了法郎的刀剑。”──

text_en: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came into the wilderness where Moses was encamped at the mountain of God, bringing Moses’ sons and wife to him.
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父耶特洛同梅瑟的儿子和妻子来到了梅瑟那里，来到旷野，靠近天主的山，梅瑟安营的地方，

text_en: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you, with your wife and her two sons. ”
text_cn: 便叫人告诉梅瑟说：“看，你的岳父耶特洛来见你，你的妻子和两个儿子也一同来了。”

text_en: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law; he bowed down and kissed him; each asked after the other’s welfare, and they went into the tent.
text_cn: 梅瑟就出来迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，口亲他，彼此问安，随后进了营幕。

text_en: Then Moses told his father-in-law all that the Lord had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardship that had beset them on the way, and how the Lord had delivered them.
text_cn: 梅瑟给他岳父讲述了上主为以色列的原故，对法郎和埃及人所行的一切，以及路上遭遇的一切困难，上主怎样拯救了他们。

text_en: Jethro rejoiced for all the good that the Lord had done to Israel, in delivering them from the Egyptians.
text_cn: 耶特洛听了上主赐给以色列的各种恩惠，从埃及人手中拯救了他们，很是高兴。

text_en: Jethro said, “Blessed be the Lord , who has delivered you from the Egyptians and from Pharaoh.
text_cn: 耶特洛说：“上主应受赞颂，他从埃及人和法郎手中拯救了你们，由埃及人手中救出了这百姓。

text_en: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods, because he delivered the people from the Egyptians, when they dealt arrogantly with them. ”
text_cn: 现今我知道‘雅威’是众神中最大的，因为他由那些傲慢对待以色列人的埃及人手中，救出这百姓。”

text_en: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God; and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父耶特洛向天主献了全燔祭和牺牲，亚郎和以色列众长老都来到天主前，同梅瑟的岳父聚餐。

text_en: The next day Moses sat as judge for the people, while the people stood around him from morning until evening.
text_cn: 次日，梅瑟坐着审判百姓的案件，百姓从早晨到晚上站在梅瑟前。

text_en: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone, while all the people stand around you from morning until evening? ”
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父看见他对百姓所行的种种，就说：“你对百姓所作的是什么事？为什么你独自一人管理，叫众百姓从早晨到晚上站在你前？”

text_en: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
text_cn: 梅瑟回答他岳父说：“因为百姓到我跟前询问天主。

text_en: When they have a dispute, they come to me and I decide between one person and another, and I make known to them the statutes and instructions of God. ”
text_cn: 他们有诉讼的事，就来到我跟前，我便在两造之间施行审判，讲明天主的典章和法律。”

text_en: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.
text_cn: 梅瑟的岳父对他说：“你这样做不对。

text_en: You will surely wear yourself out, both you and these people with you. For the task is too heavy for you; you cannot do it alone.
text_cn: 这不但使你自己疲乏，而且也使你同你在一起的百姓疲劳不堪，因为这事超过你的力量，你独自一人是不能胜任的。

text_en: Now listen to me. I will give you counsel, and God be with you! You should represent the people before God, and you should bring their cases before God;
text_cn: 现在你听我的话，我给你出一个主意。愿天主与你同在！你在天主前代表这个百姓，将他们的案件呈到天主前；

text_en: teach them the statutes and instructions and make known to them the way they are to go and the things they are to do.
text_cn: 也将典章和法律教训他们，告诉他们应走的正路，应行的事项。

text_en: You should also look for able men among all the people, men who fear God, are trustworthy, and hate dishonest gain; set such men over them as officers over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.
text_cn: 你要从百姓中挑选有才能，敬畏天主，忠实可靠，舍己无私的人，派他们作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，

text_en: Let them sit as judges for the people at all times; let them bring every important case to you, but decide every minor case themselves. So it will be easier for you, and they will bear the burden with you.
text_cn: 叫他们随时审断百姓的案件。若有任何重大案件，呈交你处理；其余一切小案件，可由他们自己处理；叫他们与你分担，你就轻松多了。

text_en: If you do this, and God so commands you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people will go to their home in peace. ”
text_cn: 你若这样作，──天主也这样命你，──你就抵受得住，众百姓也能平安，各归其所。”

text_en: So Moses listened to his father-in-law and did all that he had said.
text_cn: 梅瑟听从了他岳父的话，也都照他说的行了。

text_en: Moses chose able men from all Israel and appointed them as heads over the people, as officers over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.
text_cn: 梅瑟从全以色列人中选拔了有才能的人，立他们作百姓的头目，作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长和十夫长，

text_en: And they judged the people at all times; hard cases they brought to Moses, but any minor case they decided themselves.
text_cn: 叫他们随时审断百姓的案件；重大的案件，呈交梅瑟处理；一切小案件，由他们自己处理。

text_en: Then Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went off to his own country.
text_cn: 以后梅瑟送他岳父回了本地。
